title: Having a goal is easy.
hook: Having a goal is easy.
caption:
Having a goal is easy.
“I want to lose weight.”
“I want to get stronger.”
“I want to get healthier.”
“I want to be more disciplined.”

But wanting something and building the habits required to get it are two completely different things.

Your goal tells you where you want to go.
Your system determines what you actually do every day.

If you want to lose weight, have a plan for your food.
If you want to get stronger, schedule your training.
If you want to become healthier, build movement into your routine.
If you want to become more disciplined, start keeping the promises you make to yourself.
